hints.title: Complementary Formulation
hints.text: Maximizing chosen values such that every root-to-leaf path retains at least one node is equivalent to total sum minus the minimum retained value along all paths.

hints.title: Tree Subproblem
hints.text: For each subtree rooted at u, calculate min_lost(u): the minimum cost to retain at least one node on every root-to-leaf path starting from u.

hints.title: DP Transition
hints.text: At node u, either retain values[u] itself, or retain the sum of min_lost(v) for all children v. For leaf nodes, min_lost(u) = values[u].

hints.title: Implementation

variables: n: number of nodes in tree
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all valid subsets is exponential O(2^n).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Invert maximization into minimum path cover formulation.
